slides.title: How to stop eBook piracy on Shopify in 2027
slides.answer: No protection stops a determined person. What works on Shopify is a **personal copy for every buyer**: their name and order number inside the file, plus a hidden identifier. Few buyers share a file with their own name in it, and if a copy turns up online, it **leads back to the order** so you can block it.

slides.title: Why eBooks sold on Shopify get shared
slides.lead: Shopify sells the product. What happens to the file afterwards depends on the app that delivers it.

items.t: A normal download is the same file for every buyer. Once it is passed on, nobody knows where it came from.
A file without a name in it costs nothing to forward, upload or post. There is no reason to think twice.
Shopify does not deliver files on its own. You need an app, and free apps send the same file to everyone.

slides.title: Piracy-proof files do not exist
slides.text: No protection stops a determined person. What social DRM changes is the motive: few buyers share a file with their own name in it.

slides.title: Sealed twice: a visible note and a hidden identifier
slides.lead: When someone buys, a new copy of the file is made for that order. Pageseal does this for eBooks, PDFs and audiobooks.

items.t: A note page with the buyer's name and order number, for example “This copy was made for Alex Sample, Order #1001”. Everyone who opens the file sees whose copy it is.
A hidden identifier that stays in the file, even if someone deletes the note page. The copy stays traceable.
EPUB (reflowable and fixed layout), PDF and audiobooks as MP3, M4B, M4A or a ZIP of MP3s. One sale covers all formats of a book.

slides.title: What a good eBook watermark should do
slides.lead: Protection that annoys honest readers or breaks the book costs you more than it saves.
items: Keep the book **intact on every reader**, including fixed-layout picture books
Show the buyer's name **calmly and respectfully**, no shouting banners
Carry a **hidden identifier** that survives if the note page is deleted
Let you **look up a found file yourself**, without emailing a support team
Work for **every format you sell**: EPUB, PDF and audiobooks

slides.title: Protect your eBooks on Shopify in six steps
slides.lead: After this, every sale is sealed and delivered by itself.

items.t: Install Pageseal in your Shopify store, on any Shopify plan, and open it from Apps.
Drop in your EPUB, PDF or audiobook. One book can hold all three formats.
Green means clean, yellow looks worse on a device, red means buyers would get a broken book.
Title, cover, price, and untick “This is a physical product”, so checkout asks for no address.
Pick the Shopify product or variant that sells this book. Every sale now gets a personal copy.
Switch the book live and place a Shopify test order; test orders are free.

slides.title: Delivery settings that close the easy leaks
slides.lead: Protection inside the file works best with a delivery that buyers do not need to work around.
items: **Download limit** per buyer, for example five or ten
**Link expiry**: choose how long the link is valid
**Blocked after a refund**: the link stops working
**Download button** on the thank-you and order status page
**Delivery email** in your shop's name, logo and colours
**No account for buyers**: no login, no extra app
**Release day** for pre-orders: no download before it (from Starter)

slides.kicker: Protection must not break the book
slides.title: Check every device before the first sale
slides.lead: An EPUB that looks fine on your computer can break on a Kindle or a phone. Broken books annoy exactly the buyers who paid.

items.t: Pageseal checks every EPUB with EPUBCheck, the standard validator, and DAISY Ace, which checks accessibility.
You see your pages as Apple Books (iPhone and iPad), an Android reader, Readium and Kindle via Send to Kindle show them.
Instead of error codes, each finding says what to change in your export, before buyers see it.

slides.kicker: When a copy turns up online
slides.title: Found your eBook on a file-sharing site? Do this
slides.lead: A personal copy turns an anonymous leak into an order you can act on.

items.t: Save the shared copy exactly as you found it.
Pageseal reads the hidden identifier and names the order, even if the note page was deleted.
The leak search result has a Block copy button. One click, and that copy is blocked.
From Starter you see the buyer's name and get drafts for a takedown notice and a letter to the buyer. You decide whether to send them.

slides.title: Four mistakes that make eBook piracy easy

items.t: Without buyer details inside, a shared copy cannot be traced to anyone, so there is no reason to hold back.
A note page can be deleted. Without a hidden identifier, the trace is gone with it.
No download limit, no expiry, no block after a refund: a forwarded link keeps working for anyone who has it.
When buyers need an account, a reader app or an activation, support work grows.

slides.title: Be open about the watermark
slides.lead: Personalising a copy uses the buyer's name, which is personal data. Saying so sets expectations and is part of being open about buyer data.

items.h: Say it on the product page
items.t: For example: “Your copy is personalised with your name and order number.” Mention it in your privacy policy, too.
Pageseal processes buyer data as your processor under a data processing agreement (Article 28 GDPR), in force from installation.
Databases and files on a Hetzner server in Nuremberg. Buyer data encrypted field by field, no AI, no tracking cookies.

slides.title: eBook piracy on Shopify: questions sellers ask

items.q: Can I stop eBook piracy completely?
items.a: No. Nothing stops sharing completely. A personal copy with the buyer's name makes sharing less likely, and the hidden identifier lets you trace a shared file to its order.
A visible note page can be deleted. That is why Pageseal also adds a hidden identifier that stays in the file, so the leak search still finds the order.

items.q: Does the buyer need an account?
items.a: No. The buyer downloads a normal file from the thank-you page or the email. No login, no extra app.

items.q: Can I sell eBooks on Shopify without an app?
items.a: Not automatically. Shopify has no built-in file delivery, so you need an app. Protection apps also personalise the file.

items.q: Does a watermarked eBook work on Kindle?
items.a: Yes. Kindle buyers do not need a MOBI file any more: a personalised EPUB can be sent to a Kindle with Amazon's Send to Kindle, like any EPUB.

items.q: Which apps open the personal copy?
items.a: Any app or e-reader that opens EPUB, for example Apple Books, Google Play Books, Kobo, Tolino, PocketBook and Thorium. PDFs open in any PDF reader.

items.q: Is social DRM legal in the EU?
items.a: Personalising a copy uses the buyer's name, which is personal data. Tell buyers about it and process it under a data processing agreement; Pageseal provides one.

items.q: Can I protect audiobooks the same way?
items.a: Yes. Pageseal personalises MP3, M4B and M4A files and ZIPs of MP3s and delivers them with the eBook in one order.
